_about: One list of questions, answered by both the app (app/src/test/.../SameAnswersTest.kt, plain JUnit) and the web pages (tests/shared/test.js). The app and web/ must give the same answer to each: add a case here when a rule changes in Fetch.kt/parse.js or Occasion.kt/occasion.js. "pages" are whole product pages (2.178): the same page must give the same price, currency and 'did the page name the currency itself' (sure) in both readers; a shop that reads badly gets its page added here (ROADMAP S0.3).
